description: Precision VCO in 3HP putting out one waveform at a time, with octave, semitone and fine pitch knobs, attenuverters on both modulation inputs, and polyphony taken from the v/oct input

params.text: Sets the base octave, 0 to 10, with 4 putting 0V at the v/oct input on C4 at 261.63Hz
Transposes the pitch by up to 11 semitones either way, despite the manual saying 12
Tunes the pitch a semitone up or down
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the fm input, on an audio taper that gives fine control of small amounts, and passes none of it at centre
Sets the pulse width, 0 to 100%, with an audible effect only on the square wave
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the pwm input before it is added to the pulse width knob
Picks the waveform: sine, triangle, saw, square, even, pure sine or pure triangle, in that order; the tooltip names the one selected

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, a volt per octave; the number of channels on this cable sets how many voices run, and one voice runs with nothing patched
Modulates the pulse width through the pwm attenuverter; a monophonic cable modulates every voice, a polyphonic one modulates a voice per channel
Bends the pitch exponentially through the fm attenuverter

outputs.text: The selected waveform, polyphonic with one channel per voice

notes: the wave knob carries no marks: the tooltip Rack shows while the mouse is over the knob names the waveform selected, and nothing on the panel does
the fm and pwm attenuverters come up at zero, so a cable at either modulation input changes nothing until its attenuverter is turned off centre
